observations: Photo 0: an aluminium engine module lying on an oily workshop floor, with long mounting through-bolts, a helical drive gear and a bronze-coloured shaft end; another engine part sits behind it.
Photo 1: the same module held in a hand, showing two shaft ends with bearings, a mounting bracket and the long bolts.
Photo 2: the underside of the casting with the oil pump housing and pickup end, plug bolts and a cast mark reading '5-8'.
All photos: the casting is clean and bright with some scuffs; gear teeth visible in photo 0 look whole.
No photo shows a part number, a Toyota mark, or any label that ties the part to a car or engine.
No photo shows the part fitted, turning, or the gear and shaft play.
All photos carry a marketplace watermark with the seller's name.

identity.kind: used engine oil pump and balance shaft assembly

claims.claim: Engine oil pump balance shaft assembly
claims.evidence: Photos 0 to 2 show a balance shaft housing with a drive gear and an oil pump body.

claims.claim: For Toyota Camry 2018 to present, Toyota RAV4 and similar
claims.evidence: No part number or Toyota casting mark is readable in any photo.
Photos 0 to 2 show a clean casting with scuffs, consistent with a cleaned used part; wear inside is not shown.
Whether the assembly was ever opened cannot be shown in a photo.
No clip shows the shafts turning or the pump running.
No receipt or warranty is shown.

risks.risk: Part does not fit the engines claimed
risks.proof: Close photo of the cast or stamped part number on the housing
risks.if_unproven: as a used assembly of unknown fitment

risks.risk: Worn bearings, shaft play or chipped gear teeth
risks.proof: Clip of the drive gear turned by hand with the shafts rotating smoothly and no wobble

risks.risk: Cracked casting or damaged oil pump rotor
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full mating face and the pump cover removed

risks.risk: Part was pulled from a damaged or failed engine
risks.proof: Photo of the donor engine code plate or a clip of the engine running before removal

proof_requests: Close photo of the part number on the housing
Clip of the drive gear turned by hand with both balance shafts rotating
Photo of the full mating face of the assembly
Photo of the donor engine code
response.reason: Photos 0 to 2 clearly show a used engine oil pump and balance shaft assembly, so it can be priced by type at its worst case as not working with unknown fitment; the part number and a turning clip would raise it.
